# Babelize Elements

Open-source copy-paste Localization UI components for React and Tailwind CSS.

## Features

- Language switchers, locale pickers, RTL layouts
- Copy-paste — no installs, no lock-in
- TypeScript-first, accessible, MIT-licensed
- Works with next-intl, react-i18next, react-intl, and more

## Quick Start

```bash
mkdir -p components/elements
cp path/to/language-switcher.tsx components/elements/
```

```tsx
import { LanguageSwitcher } from "@/components/elements/language-switcher";

export function App() {
  return (
    <LanguageSwitcher
      locales={[
        { code: "en", label: "English" },
        { code: "fr", label: "Français" },
      ]}
      onLocaleChange={(code) => console.log(code)}
    />
  );
}
```
